name: Orca Tycoon
description: Every agent on your Orca host as a little pixel worker in a tycoon-style office.

cover.alt: The commons of a pixel office: agents on the sofa and at the coffee corner, a foosball table, and Palú the dog eating from his bowl

screenshots.alt: The whole office: five teams at their desks around a commons band with a lounge, kitchen, foosball table and calling booths
A team at work with a speech bubble from an agent that just finished, and Palú asleep in his bed
Desks showing agent states: a red flashing screen for blocked, an amber question mark for waiting, and specialists on stools
